title: HB1629 (2023-2024 Regular): Concerning transfers of firearms to museums and historical societies.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/biennium/2023-24/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1629.htm, downloaded directly)

operative_text: Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.113): (j) A transfer, loan, gift, or bequest to a museum or historical society, or the return of loaned firearm(s) to its lender from a museum or historical society, and museum personnel while acting in the scope of their official duties.
